name: ci-flake-detector
description: Subscribes to a `test.failed` event: re-runs the failing check up to 3× (exits early on PASS), then judge-flake decides flaky vs. real. Flakes are recorded and dropped; real regressions enter a bounded fix→verify loop supervised by judge-convergence (which STOPS on success OR oscillation), and anything still unresolved escalates to a ticket. Stops flaky reds from triggering needless repair, and real reds from being dismissed.

phases.name: rerun
phases.description: Re-run the failing check a few times to gather determinism evidence. Exits early if it passes.

body.name: rerun-check
body.description: Re-run the failing test/check and report PASS/FAIL with evidence.

phases.name: classify
phases.description: Flaky (non-deterministic) or a real regression, given the re-run evidence?

flaky.name: record-flake
flaky.description: Record the flake (quarantine candidate). No code change.

phases.name: fix-loop
phases.description: Bounded fix→verify loop; judge-convergence stops on success or on oscillation/stall.

phases.name: fix
phases.description: Implement a fix for the confirmed regression.

phases.name: verify
phases.description: Re-run the check against the fix.

phases.name: escalate-ticket
phases.description: File/annotate a ticket capturing the regression and the fix outcome (resolved or needs-human).
